dedupe_keys.name: eltramod stud teaching model for power capacity expansion and dispatch

description: ELTRAMOD-stud is a study version of an electricity market model that combines capacity expansion and power plant dispatch, built for teaching in energy economics courses. It was published on Zenodo in 2023 by Hannes Hobbie, with a detailed description in a journal paper. Assuming perfect competition and contestable markets, the cost-optimal generation portfolio it finds mimics the long-term market equilibrium with immediate capacity adjustment, as used in long-term energy scenario studies; with capacities fixed, it gives short-term market equilibria instead. Depending on the course level and students' modelling skills, the model can be extended to flexibility options, sector-coupling technologies or the effects of environmental policies. Coverage is not tied to a place; the teaching data set defines the example system. The model is downloadable from Zenodo as a ZIP under CC BY-NC 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: it is a simplified teaching model, not a planning tool, the licence forbids commercial use, and the implementation language and solver requirements are not stated on the page read. Simulation uses are learning and prototyping capacity expansion and market equilibrium analysis, including simple adequacy and policy experiments. Related records: model-temoa and model-switch are full planning models.
